facts.fact: Decree 2014-106 of 12 March 2014 states that it sets the conditions for written documents and signatures in electronic form in accordance with law no. 2013-546 of 30 July 2013 on electronic transactions, which it cites as the law it implements.
facts.system: Loi n°2013-546 du 30 juillet 2013 relative aux transactions électroniques

facts.fact: Decree 2014-106, signed by the President on 12 March 2014 under law 2013-546 on electronic transactions, sets rules on secure electronic signatures, qualified electronic certificates and the approval of certification service providers by ARTCI.
